question: How many square decimeters are 2 square meters?
solution: 1 square meter = 100 square decimeters. Thus, 2 square meters is \(2\times100=200\) square decimeters.

nodes.description: Know relative sizes of measurement units within one system of units including km, m, cm; kg, g; lb, oz.; l, ml; hr, min, sec. Generate a conversion table for feet and inches listing the number pairs (1, 12), (2, 24), (3, 36), ...
